info.name: Vultax — Public Research and Vi IQ API
info.description: The research feed and Vi IQ coverage metadata are public. IQ observations require a private consumer key or enabled marketplace subscription. Keep apiToken in a private environment. Read-only Vi IQ crypto observations with six factors, source timestamps, coverage and producer fallback notes. A consumer key or marketplace subscription is required for IQ data. Source-reported indicators are not forecasts; metadata reports actual observed history and model-version availability. Methodology: https://vultax.com/methodology
